gate_typing.CONSISTENCY: would have refuted, cannot prove (the 432-frame count)
gate_typing.CORROBORATION: feeds no theorem gate (the pointbank regression)
gate_typing.EXECUTED: a finite computation with no theorem content beyond itself
gate_typing.SECOND_PROOF: an independent route to the same unconditional statement

mutation_policy.census_rule: deleting a gate is a FAIL, caught by CENSUS_COMPLETE and again by the runner's comparison against the sealed census hash
mutation_policy.must_fail_rule: each entry names the gate that has to report the failure; an unnamed failure elsewhere does not count
mutation_policy.must_survive_rule: a battery in which every mutation fails is testing its plumbing, not the certificate; M_CLASS_REP_EPS_SQUARED (eps -> eps^2) and M_CLASS_GENERATOR_BASIS (a different basis of the same Delta) must PASS

producer_execution.bounded_local_tests: preflight P1-P7: 36/36 Python gates PASS, 35 MUST_FAIL + 2 MUST_SURVIVE + 2 gate unit tests PASS, GP static census 79/79 and 21/21 observables
producer_execution.pari_gp_not_run_reason: no gp on the producer host; the GP layer is hand-reviewed and statically census-audited by preflight_r1.py, and is executed only on the registered AWS host

required_before_execution: a hostile source review by a DIFFERENT model with verdict PASS, hash-recorded in the authorization
a coordinator GO recorded as coordinator_go=true in the authorization
the coordinator-supplied gp binary path and SHA-256 (runner refuses an unpinned binary)
an instance type from the registered allowlist matching the live IMDS value exactly
status_note: This status field is immutable. Authorization lives in a separate coordinator record whose SHA-256 is the live EC2 tag value; the preregistration is never edited to authorize a launch.
stop_conditions: any pinned source, pointbank, GP-script, census or observable hash drifts
the two engines disagree on any one of the 21 shared observables
any GP gate line prints 0, the GP gate count is not 79, the census line disagrees, or any line of GP output fails to parse
any Python gate fails or is missing from the executed census
any MUST_FAIL mutation does not fire its named gate, or any MUST_SURVIVE mutation is rejected
any artifact would name a component other than K0, a component count other than 1, or a nontrivial idempotent
any live EC2 identity, tag, authorization, host, gp binary, service user, cgroup, cpuset, swap, memory, tasks, runtime, run-path, manifest, archive or terminal binding fails
the run path already exists, or any artifact path already exists
the unit exceeds 300 seconds, the runner exceeds 240 seconds, gp exceeds 120 seconds, any output exceeds its cap, or any swap is nonzero
